cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll lend you the ladder for two lifts to the station.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only need it for five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. One lift, then. And tell your wife my roses have improved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Five pounds. Three if you say we're still friends when you hand it over.

mechanism: A grants a ladder loan and changes its price from an assumed superior position, making even reassurance a negotiable concession.
confusable: A fair rental agreement would price equipment; this pair must negotiate favors and friendship while retaining authority to approve each form of payment.
comparison: The neighbor loan trades practical and emotional currencies; the apology alternative trades holiday time for genuine forgiveness.
seedUse: Use D22-a payment and friendship terms, with S01 permission controlling how B may settle the favor.
